name: digital-duck
description: An unofficial desktop pet inspired by Pollen's Microduck.
author: Gurpreet Singh

scripts.start:log: mkdir -p state && npm run build && ./node_modules/.bin/electron . 2>&1 | tee -a state/duck.log
scripts.dist: scripts/check-public.sh && npm run build && npm run helpers && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.release: scripts/check-public.sh && npm run build && npm run helpers && electron-builder --mac --publish always

extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Digital Duck reads your calendar to remind you before meetings, if you turn that on.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Digital Duck reads your calendar to remind you before meetings, if you turn that on.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Digital Duck checks whether Music or Spotify is playing so it can dance along.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Digital Duck listens when you press the talk key, if you turn voice input on.
